summary.name: StreamWindow
summary.one_liner: StreamWindow is a 3D window manager for macOS that previews and switches open windows using Cover Flow-style effects, hotkeys, and multi-display support.
use_cases: switching between many open windows on macOS
organizing windows in horizontal, vertical or bird's-eye layouts
summary.what_it_does: StreamWindow shows macOS windows as 3D previews with CoverFlow, WatchCard, PokerShuffle and Carousel effects. It supports keyboard shortcuts for quick switching. Windows can be arranged in Horizontal, Vertical, or Bird's-eye view layouts. It also supports multi-display setups for complex workspaces. The page does not describe pricing details beyond a App Store link.
notable: Cover Flow, Watch Card, and Poker Shuffle 3D window previews
Horizontal, vertical, and bird's-eye layout options
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page; App Store listing is linked
